name: Crescendo Sonore
description: Véritable nexus de données vivant, Crescendo Sonore appartient au Chœur Synthétique. Il module les fréquences du réseau pour transcender le chaos, transformant la bataille en une symphonie cybernétique parfaite.

subject.archetype: Synthetic Choir Combat Medic Android - Faceless humanoid android in the guise of a cyber-ascetic monk, smooth ceramic and steel body devoid of any human features, emanating harmonic vibrations that distort the surrounding air

loadout.armor_outfit: Tattered ceremonial robes fashioned from braided synthetic fiber cables and worn thick fabric in faded monastic brown and dark grey, ceramic plate armor integrated in Buddhist monk vestment patterns across the torso, holographic golden runic symbols orbiting the body in slow rotation
loadout.arsenal: Palm-mounted dimensional pressure field emitters on both hands projecting a visible expanding wall of force, wearable harmonic resonance diffuser device mounted on the upper back emitting healing waveforms, twin electrified pilgrim staffs strapped diagonally across the back crackling with golden energy

attitude.behavior: Rushing at full sprint into the line of fire through a shattered crystalline amphitheater, weaving and dodging crystal fragments and projectiles while both hands thrust forward in a powerful pushing motion, healing equipment deployed and humming, creating a massive visible dimensional pressure field expanding from the palms against the opposing forces
attitude.emotion: Serene and impassive determination radiating from the smooth faceless ceramic mask, eyes absent but presence commanding, absolute focus on protecting allies while compassion drives the urgent rescue mission

palette_names.role: Android facial surface and exposed body plating

palette_names.role: Runic mantras, healing waveforms, pressure field energy

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic mixed-source lighting with golden holographic glow emanating from the palm emitters and orbiting runes, cold blue-white light from shattered crystal fragments, dramatic rim lighting from behind highlighting the silhouette, volumetric rippling in the air from resonant vibrations
color_and_light.mood: Desperate heroic determination, solemn martial compassion, a fleeting moment of salvation amid chaotic destruction

camera.angle: Low angle dutch tilt positioned at ground level looking upward at the android mid-stride, emphasizing heroic presence, the expansive pressure wall, and the looming shattered ceiling

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater transformed into a chaotic battlefield, massive crystal formations fractured and exploding outward from harmonic overload, jagged crystal shards of all sizes suspended in mid-air or raining down from the resonating cracked domed ceiling, entire environment visibly vibrating at frequencies that cause the air itself to ripple and distort
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Concentric shockwave rings of pure dimensional force tearing visibly through enemy positions, crystal fragments caught in slow-motion by resonant frequencies, golden healing waveforms mixing with destructive harmonic blasts, the android's presence causing the very air to shimmer and wobble, dust and debris suspended in mid-air by standing pressure waves
